HediffDef.label: predator reflex organ
HediffDef.description: A Wraith-derived reflex organ that sharpens target tracking, close-quarters evasion and predatory response timing. D108 balance values remain provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: myomer reinforcement gland
HediffDef.description: A cultivated Wraith gland that reinforces neuromuscular output. D108 balance values remain provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: regenerative vesicle
HediffDef.description: A living Wraith vesicle that accelerates ordinary tissue repair and reduces bleeding. It does not regenerate missing parts or erase permanent scars.

HediffDef.label: metabolic reserve node
HediffDef.description: A Wraith metabolic node that reduces food demand and slows exhaustion. D108 balance values remain provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: sensory crown organ
HediffDef.description: A Wraith neural-sensory crown that heightens sight, hearing and low-level psychic sensitivity. D108 balance values remain provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: vital feedback organ
HediffDef.description: A defensive Wraith-derived organ that interrupts hostile Wraith life-force transfer and feeds a painful bioelectric backlash into the attacking feeder.

HediffDef.label: nanite motor lattice
HediffDef.description: An Asuran-derived motor lattice that reinforces movement, manipulation and weapon alignment. D108 balance values remain provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: autonomic efficiency lattice
HediffDef.description: An Asuran autonomic lattice that reduces metabolic and rest demand. D108 balance values remain provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: adaptive sensor mesh
HediffDef.description: An Asuran sensory mesh that improves sight, hearing and ranged target acquisition. D108 balance values remain provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: reconstruction microforge
HediffDef.description: A compact Asuran microforge that slowly repairs ordinary non-permanent injuries. It cannot erase scars, replace missing parts or resurrect the dead. D108 repair rate remains provisional pending playtesting.

HediffDef.label: EMP shunt lattice
HediffDef.description: An Asuran shunt lattice that shortens disruptive EMP cascades through nanite physiology. It does not grant EMP immunity.
